scope: Read-only review of the two frozen production files only; not an independent review or execution of the six new regression cases.
reviewed_boundaries: The one-second manager policy is new and cooperative; its common deadline covers one request and subsequent existing watch observation, not synchronous driver preemption or manager lock/cleanup time.
Entry already-exited and original observe_current_exit remain unchanged. A previously retained failure remains the returned first failure after one cleanup attempt.
Request errors and request timeout remain errors even if a native exit arrives concurrently. The new observation path begins only after successful request completion.
Delayed exit confirmation uses one watch ProcessState snapshot and changed notification; no new polling/read RPC or separate raw exit getters.
Deadline final check runs under state_tx.send_modify, retaining a native exit already recorded there and retaining the first observation failure otherwise.
Manager releases the store mutex before awaiting, retains unconfirmed owners, and keeps the original Arc::ptr_eq and initial-exec identity checks before removal.
Original Drop and unconfirmed terminate cleanup remain outside this entry; at-most-once means per terminate_confirmed invocation, not a global no-further-cleanup promise.
limitations: Source review only, no Rust commands or active log reads.
Six new regression cases were intentionally left to the root independent review and native original gates.
No claim of original Core or full workspace success.
